name: Neo-Brutalist
tagline: Thick rules, hard shadows, loud primaries.
description: A system that shows its construction. Heavy black outlines, offset shadows with no blur, and three primaries used at full strength. It reads as confident and a little rude, which suits tools for people who build things.

fonts.role: display and UI; use font-stretch 125% for display

do: Outline every surface with a 2px line; use 3px for the primary action and hero elements
Give interactive surfaces the 4px hard shadow; on press, translate 2px right and down and shrink the shadow to 2px
Set display headlines in Archivo at font-stretch 125% and weight 800 or 900, tracking tight
Use Martian Mono for labels, numbers, and metadata, uppercase only for labels under 12 words
Rotate one sticker element per screen by -2deg to break the grid on purpose
Use yolk as the main accent; tomato for destructive and for one loud highlight per screen
dont: Do not use soft or blurred shadows
Do not use more than three accent colors on one screen
Do not use thin 1px borders on interactive elements
Do not center every section; anchor most layouts to the left edge

components.name: Button
components.notes: Primary is yolk with a 3px outline. Pressed state moves 2px and the shadow shrinks to 2px. Destructive is tomato.

components.name: Input
components.notes: 2px outline, surface fill, mono label above. Error state swaps the outline to tomato and adds a mono error line.

components.name: Select
components.notes: Native select with a square chevron block on the right, separated by a 2px rule.

components.name: Checkbox and toggle
components.notes: Square checkbox with a heavy check. Switch is a rectangle track with a square thumb and the hard shadow.

components.name: Badge
components.notes: Mono uppercase, 2px outline, flat fill. The sticker variant is rotated -2deg.

components.name: Card
components.notes: 2px outline, 4px hard shadow, header strip in an accent color separated by a rule.

components.name: Navbar
components.notes: Bottom rule of 3px. Mobile menu is a details disclosure that drops a full-width outlined panel.

components.name: Modal and sheet
components.notes: Backdrop is ink at 60 percent. Dialog has a 3px outline and an 8px hard shadow.

components.name: Table
components.notes: Every cell ruled. Header row inverted (ink background, bg text), mono numbers right-aligned.

components.name: Bento grid
components.notes: Tiles share outlines with a gap of 12px; each tile uses a different accent or none.

components.name: Empty state
components.notes: Dashed 2px outline box, a large mono glyph drawn in CSS, one primary action.

components.name: Toast
components.notes: Outlined bar with a colored square status block on the left and a square dismiss button.
